summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd., an Israeli 3D-printing plant-based meat technology company, filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the commercial launch of its Perfecta Premium Plant-Based Meat brand at retail outlets across the northeastern United States. The rollout is supported by distribution through KeHE Distributors. Products include plant-based marbled steak, filet mignon, chicken breast, and fish patties. No financial terms, transaction structure, or strategic event are disclosed. This is a routine product launch announcement, not a special situation. The filing merely reports operational progress and does not trigger any corporate event classification, so the appropriate category is None.
